title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Hidden Pairs Mahjong
description: Match and clear all the tile in this Hidden Pairs Mahjong solitaire game. Use your observation skills to find and select identical open tiles to remove them from the board. With beautifully designed classic Mahjong symbols, smooth animations, and a calming background, each level offers a fresh puzzle challenge.Earn bonus time, increase your score, and progress through endless levels of tile-matching fun!

title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2
description: The beloved classic returns! In Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2, connect matching butterflies in this beautifully refreshed game,  featuring new wing colors, enhanced animations, updated UI, and countless levels to complete . Can you clear each level before time runs out? Collect coins to unlock new backgrounds and stunning butterfly wings in the updated shop! A relaxing, fun puzzle for all ages!

title: Fix Da Brainrot
description: Fix Da Brainrot is a quirky jigsaw puzzle game with pieces that look like torn paper. Pick your challenge —16 pieces for a quick and easy fix or 32 pieces for a real brain teaser. Drag, drop, and fit the torn pieces together, and watch the picture slowly come alive as you fix the brainrot and conquer the puzzle!

title: Woody Tap Block
description:
Woody Tap Block is an addictive puzzle game where you have to use logical thinking to move and remove wooden blocks in the right direction. With simple yet challenging mechanics, the game offers a relaxing yet engaging experience.
Plan your moves in the correct order to clear all the blocks.
As you progress through levels, the puzzles become more challenging with new obstacles and block types to overcome.

title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
description: Get ready for the cutest twist on the viral Brainrot universe! Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker is the baby-themed sequel to the hit Brainrot Clicker! Tap your way through the baby versions of your favorite characters, collect upgrades, and enjoy a whole new atmosphere with colorful visuals, cheerful music, and fresh sound effects designed to fit the playful baby theme!

title: Number Domination
description: Number Domination is a turn-based strategy card game where players compete to claim tiles on the board using number cards (0-9). Create chains of three or more, match pairs, or make a "Perfect 9" by summing two cards to 9. Each successful move earns points and claims tiles. At the end, each occupied tile grants an extra point to its owner. Play in Face the Challenger or Face the Champion mode and win with smart moves. Think ahead, outplay your opponent, and dominate the numbers!

title: Imposter 3D
description: Brace yourself for a thrilling challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and guide them into the holes each round. Afterward, head to the store to snag upgrades and cool items to power up your game. Complete levels, gather diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to boost your progress. How far can you take your skills? The further you go, the greater the rewards!

title: Merge Christmas
description: Merge Christmas is a festive puzzle game where you combine matching snowballs to create new character / bigger snowballs, and unlock a cozy Christmas world. Relax and merge Christmas-themed snowballs in a cheerful winter atmosphere perfect for the holiday season.

title: Office Brawl - Room Smash
description:
Become the hero of an office rebellion and destroy everything in your path! The player will have to transform into a disgruntled employee who challenges the system, destroys obstacles and fights the boss.

Use brute force and ingenuity to get through difficult tests, participate in intense battles and explosive actions.
Become an antihero and sow chaos from start to finish!

title: Volley Beans - Volleyball Game
description: Get ready to become the best volleyball player of all time! Jump right now into this cute and simple, yet challenging volleyball game!

title: Cat Cut
description: A fun game about a hungry cat, get him a fish, cut the rope so that it falls directly to the cat. All objects move according to physics, do not miss the fish, do not upset the cat!

title: Cute Folding Paper
description: Cute Folding Paper is an origami online puzzle game. Combines the creative fun of paper crafts with challenging logic puzzle challenges, making it the perfect game for kids and family play .Perfect for children and good for practicing logic, reasoning, and problem-solving skills. Step by step, solve puzzling origami puzzles where the order of folding is the key to clearing the level.What are you waiting for? If you like our games, please share them with your friends to double the fun!

title: Epic Car Stunt Race Obby
description: Epic Car Stunt Race Obby is a fast-paced, acrobatic and challenging stunt racing game. In these races with hundreds of different levels, each new track creates a completely different excitement with its special design. You can play Epic Car Stunt Race Obby against AI racers or with your friend in 2 player mode. Start the endless racing excitement now!

title: Astral Escape
description: Astral Escape is a thrilling space game where you dodge asteroids, outsmart aliens, and survive cosmic traps in a fast escape game adventure. Explore galaxies in a sci-fi arcade escape with astronaut missions and star quests. Fans of cool math games, Roblox, Minecraft, snake game, or Kahoot-style challenges will enjoy this galaxy escape quest. Astral Escape blends action, strategy, and fun into one cosmic survival run.

title: Animal Merge Zoo Park
description:
Animal Merge Zoo Park is a fun and addictive idle zoo simulation game where you build, manage, and expand your very own wildlife empire. Start with a small zoo and grow it into a world filled with animals, wild beasts, dinosaurs, monsters, and magical creatures like unicorns. Become the ultimate zoo tycoon by merging creatures, caring for animals, producing food, managing visitors, and unlocking new zones.
Merge Animals and Discover New Species

title: Dragon Hunter
description:
Choose your character, roll the dice and go on a fun adventure.
Click on monsters - help the hero survive and defeat the legendary dragons in the clicker RPG Dragon Hunter.
Luck and a strong phone glass will determine the fate of the dragon hunter.

title: Soccer Arena X
description: Soccer Arena X is an exciting football game that delivers dynamic matches, simple controls, and colorful arcade gameplay. Every match is fast, fun, and full of energy, giving you the ultimate multiplayer football experience. As you progress, you’ll collect coins and gems to unlock powerful abilities like freeze, lightning, super kick, or a giant head, adding a bright and entertaining arcade style to the gameplay. Step onto the pitch, score goals, and become a football star!

title: Survival Sword Battle
description: Survival Sword Battle throws you into a ruthless sword-fighting free-for-all battle where a single hit means defeat. Fight to unlock all 10 character evolutions and boost your speed with each upgrade. Can you dominate the leaderboard and survive the longest?

title: My Parking Lot
description: Welcome to "My Parking Lot," the ultimate puzzle challenge! Navigate through a chaotic mess of cars stuck in a parking lot and strategize to safely remove each vehicle without crashing them into each other. Your goal? Clear the parking lot by guiding all the cars to the exit, unlocking new levels as you master the art of precision parking. Can you untangle the traffic and solve each puzzle with finesse? Test your skills in "My Parking Lot" now!

title: Ship Parking Game
description: Solve colorful passenger seating puzzles on ships in this unique traffic jam puzzle game. Help passengers find their seats based on color patterns while managing the flow of people through parking lot-style challenges. It's not just about parking - you're a traffic director managing passenger jams on the high seas.

title: Lemonade Tycoon Idle
description: Tap your way from a humble lemonade stand to a global empire! Serve customers, unlock upgrades, hire staff, and expand across the world. With a dynamic day/night cycle and relaxing lo-fi music, this is the ultimate idle lemonade experience.

title: Labubu Pop
description:
Labubu Pop is a bright and cheerful puzzle game where the playful Labubus have completely taken over the box! Connect matching characters into chains, clear the board, and earn points to level up. Each stage brings fun surprises, and even more exciting combos!

With its colorful visuals, smooth animations, and simple yet addictive gameplay, Labubu Pop is perfect for relaxing and having fun anytime. The longer your chain — the higher your score and the flashier the effects!

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: iColorcoin Sort Puzzle
description: icolorcoin  a reflexes and strategy thinking game.,designed color  sort game! This game so creativity and gameplay. this game like Ball Sort, Water Sort, and merge games is its incredibly straightforward gameplay. Your objective is to arrange chips of the same color together and merge them into larger numbers when a grid is filled, creating a challenging and addictively fun game, for all ages.

title: Farm Tiles Harvest
description: Dive into 'Farm Tiles Harvest,' an engaging tile-matching game set in a quaint farm setting! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring fruits, veggies, and farming tools. Try to draw 3 similar tiles to clear them, or drawing the 9th tile will end the game. Shuffle tiles to reveal hidden ones, and complete each level within the time limit. Can you harvest them all?

title: Neon Blast
description: Upgrade your defense cannons by merging them!Watch as your cannons level up and become powerful defenders, and get exciting new powers to crush bosses and attackers!

title: Fill One Line
description:
Dive into the world of fascinating logic and test your mind in an exciting puzzle! Your task is to draw a line across the entire playing field, filling it completely, but keep in mind: there will be obstacles on the way that you need to bypass.

The game offers many levels, from simple to incredibly difficult, allowing each player to choose a suitable challenge.

title: Cafe Owner Business Simulator
description: Build your dream cafe and become a successful business owner in Cafe Owner: Business Simulator! Restore your dad cafe and turn an abandoned space into a thriving restaurant. This exciting and simulation game lets you experience what it’s like to run your own cafe, from cleaning up to expanding into a successful cafe business.

title: Dessert DIY
description: Step into a sweet little food studio and craft desserts for hungry customers! Follow simple step-by-step recipes, pick the right ingredients, and assemble tasty treats exactly as requested. Satisfy each guest to earn coins, then spend your rewards in the shop to unlock more items, upgrades, and delicious options. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and full of colorful desserts!

title: Just Slap It!
description:
Just Slap It is a fun and lighthearted slap-based game where timing and accuracy are key. Compete in slap battles, perfect your timing, and climb the leaderboard to showcase your skills.

With simple controls and engaging gameplay, challenge yourself to out-slap opponents and rise to the top. Unlock upgrades and enjoy quick, casual fun anytime.

title: Royal Garden Match
description: Welcome to Royal Garden Match! You’ve inherited a grand Royal Castle and a once-beautiful garden—now it’s up to you to bring its beauty to life! Solve exciting match-3 puzzles by combining exquisite royal flowers, fruits, and plants to unlock powerful boosters. With hundreds of challenging levels, unique royal characters, and a magical journey ahead, there's always something new to discover. Can you make the royal garden flourish? Play now and start your enchanting adventure!

title: Ole Bunny
description: Ole Bunny plunges you into a crazy arena where a cute bunny finds himself because of his love for roses ! Now you must show courage and skill to escape the wild bulls and collect as many fragrant roses as possible. Can you become the best bunny matador of all time?

title: World War 2 Shooter
description: World War 2 Shooter is a new first person shooter where you can become a real soldier of World War 2 and fight against enemies! Defeat foes in dynamic battles and be a hero on the battlefield!

title: Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames
description: Visit the BerryWorks cafeteria and play checkers, memory, tic-tac-toe, connecting pairs, and complete jigsaw puzzles with your friends.

title: Lovie Chic's Coachella Festival
description: Step into the vibrant world of Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival, the ultimate festival dress-up game! Style your character with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to shine at the iconic Coachella Festival. With simple controls and endless creativity, Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: Color Dash
description: Color Dash is a fast-paced endless runner that tests your reflexes and color matching skill! Pilot a speeding rocket and match its color to smash through colored gates. Dodge the wrong colors and react to frantic color changes to keep your run alive. Grab powerful shield and nitro power-ups to blast further and beat your personal best score in this addictive arcade adventure. How high can you score?

title: Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow
description: Play Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow – a relaxing and colorful butterfly-matching puzzle game with fresh mechanics and vibrant rainbow visuals! Enjoy hundreds of exciting levels, earn daily rewards, take part in special events, and unlock beautiful new wings. A fun Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Office Escape to Date
description: You have a date after work, but theres a catch: you need to get ready without your boss catching you! Complete your tasks, and prepare for your date before time runs out. But be careful, if the boss appears, quickly close the activity to avoid getting caught and return to work. How fast can you escape the office and be ready in time?

title: Card Solitaire: Word Game
description:
Train your brain in a fun new way with Card Solitaire: Word Game — a clever blend of card sorting, word puzzles, and logic challenges!
Explore the exciting world of word solitaire, packed with clever associations, tricky word sort levels, and fun topic sort puzzles.

title: Emoji Drop Themes
description: Dive into the addictive fun of Emoji Drop, a delightful physics puzzle game where strategy meets chain reactions! Drop a variety of charming items, from classic emojis and juicy fruits to wild animals into the container. The magic happens when two matching items touch, merging into something new and bigger. With a challenging Adventure Mode and a relaxing Classic Mode, can you master the merge and discover the final, ultimate item?

title: Last Day On Earth Survival
description: Last Day on Earth: Survival is a 2D survival simulation game. In this large ruined city, you have 51 locations to discover. When you collect some wood and metal, you can make weapons on the Workbench. When you win enough experience and level up, you can check your Attribute and upgrade HP, ATK, Speed, and Search. In the day, explore and go to places you have never visited. I hope you will survive 50 days and explore all 51 locations.

title: Cosmo Puzzle
description: Cosmo Puzzle is a colorful puzzle game about a robot who dreams of collecting a collection of minerals from all over the Solar System.

title: Port Shipping Tycoon
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure as you build your own shipping empire in this addictive tile-flipping game! With just one click, start constructing your port business by flipping tiles to supply resources to bustling ports around the world.

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: Farm Block
description: Farm Block is an engaging farm-themed puzzle game where players slide adorable animal blocks to free them from the farm. Test your strategic thinking and enjoy the charming countryside setting! With its mix of puzzle-solving and elimination mechanics, Farm Block offers a fun and rewarding challenge for all ages.

title: Color Strings
description: Looking for a simple way to exercise your brain every day? Try Color Strings! This game features straightforward rules and fun, challenging gameplay. In this puzzle game, you need to rearrange the strings on the dots to match the given pattern. With various puzzle levels, you'll keep your brain sharp in just a few minutes each day.

title: Detective - Logic Puzzles
description:
Become a Detective! Solve logic puzzles to find the criminal! 
Lots of levels and interesting stories!

You will have to solve a lot of different cases, in this you will be helped by the method of deduction known to all detectives.

title: Solitaire Tail
description: Raise your dragons at Solitaire! Clear the game by moving all cards to the foundation! Move cards from the tableau or stockpile in ascending order of the same suit. In the tableau, you can stack cards in descending order with alternating colors! You can place a King card in an empty column! When there are no available moves, you can draw cards from the stockpile to the foundation or tableau!

title: Shanghai Chef
description:
A fun and fast-paced matching game where you need to find and connect the same blocks! 
Test your reflexes and observation skills as you quickly spot matching pairs. 
Can your hands move faster than your eyes can track? 
Pay close attention to which blocks can be linked together and clear the board as fast as possible!

title: Labubu Coloring Adventure
description: Labubu Coloring Adventure is a splashy journey into a world full of color, fun, and furry mischief!. Grab your digital crayons and bring Labubu and friends to life with every stroke!. From goofy grins to magical backgrounds, every page is a new surprise! Explore, color, giggle, and create your own cartoon adventure with Labubu!. It’s not just coloring: it’s a giggle-filled adventure waiting at every tap!

title: Hero Wizard: Save Your Girlfriend
description: One day when I woke up, I saw that my girlfriend wasn't beside me, so I started searching around for her but couldn't find her. Then I noticed a letter on the table, and the letter said: "If you want to see your girlfriend again, you'll have to pass through the magic forest to rescue her, but it won't be easy because you're not alone in the forest!" At first, I didn't understand, but..

title: Flames & Fortune
description: Dive into "Flames & Fortune," a game inspired by Card Crawl, set in treacherous dungeons. Play as the Pyro-Paladin, mastering a deck of 54 cards to battle foes like goblins and dragons. Strategy determines survival and success brings gold to unlock new skills. Will you conquer the darkness for untold riches?

title: Winter Solitaire TriPeaks
description:
Take a break from the holiday bustle and unwind with Winter Solitaire TriPeaks!
Play over 500 frosty levels and clear shimmering, ice-covered tableaus. Escape into a peaceful winter wonderland filled with enchanting scenes that evolve as you build magical locations throughout the game. From a cozy cottage to a snow-dusted palace, every setting is a feast for the eyes.

Discover the most heart-warming Solitaire experience of the season — and let the snowflakes guide your cards to victory!

title: Quest by Country
description: Quest by Country - an engaging game that allows players to identify countries by their flags. This captivating task serves as an educational tool, expanding players' knowledge of the diversity of countries and the symbolism conveyed through their flags.

title: Office Knight 3D: Castle Defense
description:
Office Warrior: Wield swords and axes as skillfully as a stapler!
Action Battles: Fight various enemies in dynamic 3D environments.
Progression System: Level up, improve health and damage right in the heat of battle.
Weapon & Upgrade Shop: Collect coins to buy hero upgrades and equip yourself.
Endless Challenge: Deflect waves of enemies and prove you are the ultimate defender!

title: Finger Heart Monster Refill
description:
Do you love Finger Heart posing? Do you want to make Finger Heart with a cute character? Let's Play This Game. In Finger Heart: Monster Refill, you must choose how to fit your finger with other
adorable monsters to form a perfect heart. To fill a perfect heart, you don’t need any special skills, just use your imagination and creativity.  They can change its shape in many ways. You'll need to think carefully about which form fits the shape of your fingers. Come make hearts with cute monsters!

title: Disk Rush
description: Disk Rush is a reaction-based arcade game where players must quickly sort colored disks into their matching zones. The game challenges your speed and accuracy as disks appear faster over time. With simple tap mechanics and increasing difficulty, Disk Rush tests your ability to think and act quickly under pressure.

title: Tiny Farm
description:
Tiny Farm is a small, cozy farming game where everything grows at your pace.

Harvest crops, collect goods from animals, and slowly upgrade your farm into something wonderful. Each upgrade brings visible progress, and each world unlocks exciting new possibilities.

Sit back, relax, and watch your tiny farm flourish.

title: Sea Match
description: See Match is a challenging match-3 puzzle game. Connect 3 or more of the same fishes horizontally or diagonally. The more fishes you match, the higher your score! Keep an eye on the time. You will fail to pass the level if you do not gather sufficient grids in time. The faster you complete the task, the more stars you earn! If you find yourself stuck, you can always use the special bonuses to help you.

title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to Farm Animal Sort Puzzle, a fun and relaxing casual puzzle game set on a lively farm. Your mission is simple but addictive: match the appropriate animal or vegetable to the customer's needs. Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

title: Bunnys Farm
description: Embark on a delightful fruit match-3 adventure with Bunny's Farm: Zen Match Master. Join your cheerful companion, Bunny, as you traverse diverse landscapes—from lush meadows and snowy peaks to desert dunes and tropical beaches. Match juicy fruits like oranges and peaches to solve engaging puzzles, uncover enchanting stories, and unlock new chapters in this relaxing yet challenging journey.

title: Pet Me Maze
description:
Welcome to Pet Me Maze, the most hilarious and addictive maze puzzle game that combines humor, challenge, and adorable pets
Are you ready to test your wits and reflexes in a maze full of surprises, traps, and funny moments

title: Supermarket Manager Simulator
description: Supermarket Manager Simulator is a business game. Have you ever fantasized about running your supermarket in your childhood?  Play as the store manager in this game and stock up on a variety of goods, from chips and fries to meats, burgers, vegetables, and fruits. From stocking, and shelving to selling, you will be the one to take care of it!  Don't hesitate to start your entrepreneurial journey now and become a great store tycoon!

title: Maze Escape : Craft Man
description:
Objective:
Navigate through a series of craft doors and escape the maze without being killed by terrifying entities.

Gameplay:

    Explore the Maze: Move through a maze filled with multiple doors, each leading to new and more challenging areas.
    Survive the Entities: Avoid or outsmart various entities that lurk in the maze, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns.
    Find the Next Door: Continuously search for the next door to progress to subsequent levels of the maze.
    Collect Items: Gather keys to unlock doors, coins for upgrades, and useful tools to aid in your survival.

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: Money ping pong
description:
Money ping pong is a casual idle game where you need to deftly install money blocks, use them to reduce the space for balls and earn money faster and more money!

There are many different maps
and dozens of functional blocks
Relaxing gameplay

title: Mahjong Sort Puzzle
description: This is an addictive matching puzzle game. If you are a mahjong fan and love matching games, this game is for you. You need to sort out the mahjongs, sort out the mahjongs with the same colour into a grid and they will all be eliminated. While playing the game, you will also exercise your logical thinking and spatial sense. So, come and join the challenging world of gaming.

title: Burger Empire
description:
Welcome to Burger & Beans Cafe, the ultimate restaurant-management game where you cook juicy burgers, brew the perfect coffee, and build the eatery of your dreams!

• Serve Delicious Orders: Flip patties and pour lattes for hungry customers—fast!
• Earn & Upgrade: Collect coins to unlock chic new tables, comfy booths, and vibrant dining areas.
• Customize Your Space: Choose décor, layout, and special menu items to keep guests coming back.

title: Parkour Obby
description: Dive into the ultimate parkour adventure with Parkour Obby! Immerse yourself in a world of stunning, blocky beauty inspired by iconic Minecraft graphics. Leap, sprint, and climb through meticulously crafted levels, each more breathtaking than the last. From towering cliffs to dazzling pixelated landscapes, every jump tests your skills, timing, and creativity.

title: Water Sort
description: Experience the simple yet addictive water sorting puzzle game! It’s the ultimate free game for training your brain, killing time, and relaxing!

title: Granny Returns 3D : Evil Destiny
description:
Step into a terrifying haunted house in Granny Returns 3D Evil Destiny, where danger lurks around every corner. Trapped in a sinister mansion, your only goal is to escape before the evil granny finds you. Solve intricate puzzles, search for hidden keys, and move silently to avoid detection.

With immersive 3D graphics, eerie sound effects, and unpredictable jump scares, this game will keep you on edge.

title: Bubble Shooter Ultimate
description: Bubble shooter ultimate is a classic bubble shooter game with a modern twist. Each level-up you get to chose a power up like a change to get a bomb or rainbow bubble and more. Create combinations of three or more matching bubbles by launching bubbles of the same color at them. The more bubbles you pop in a single shot, the higher your score. If you miss a match 5 times, the playing field moves down by one row. The objective is to score as many points as possible while clearing all the bubbles!

title: One HERO
description:
One Hero: Dive into the ultimate action-packed shooting game! Play as a lone hero, dodging and shooting your way through waves of enemies. Eliminate all foes to claim victory. Are you ready to be the last one standing?
Dive into a thrilling, action-packed adventure where you’ll face waves of enemies and intense boss battles.
With intuitive controls and accessible gameplay, players of all skill levels can jump in and start unleashing chaos in no time.

title: 3Dash
description: 3Dash is a fast-paced 3D rhythm platformer inspired by Geometry Dash—dash, jump, and flip through dizzying, rotating tracks while keeping perfect time. Tackle six hand-crafted levels, then build your own with the level editor for endless replay

title: Merge Rush Z
description: Merge Rush Z is an addictive free zombie shooter game where you merge powerful guns to battle zombies with your heroine and her squad. Zombies pose a variety of challenges with their size, speed, abilities and powerful bosses! Engage in thrilling firing action, using a combination of guns, deadly items and your wits to clear the zombie waves. Tap, bang and blast your way to survive the Zombie Outbreak!

title: Merge Car Defense
description:
Prepare to battle wave upon wave of relentless enemies as you skilfully merge and upgrade the defences of your cars.

Build out a roster of cars and use them tactically in order to defeat the enemy, collect coins and be victorious!

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: Ninja Climb
description: Embark on a thrilling ascent in Ninja Climb, a captivating 2D game where your nimble ninja scales towering buildings. Click to seamlessly leap between structures, dodging obstacles along the way, and utilize rewarded video ads to revive when challenges arise, ensuring an adrenaline-packed ninja adventure.

title: Find It In The Haunted Mansion
description: “Find It In The Haunted Mansion” is a finding style game, where you are a detective and need to find all the keys hidden in each part of the house to complete all the levels.

title: Cute Craft Lab
description: Step into the colorful world of Cute Craft Lab, a super casual game where creativity shines and every girl can become a true crafting designer. If you love relaxing gameplay mixed with adorable creativity, this cute design adventure is made just for you. In Cute Craft Lab, enter a magical workshop filled with charming tools, sparkling decorations, and endless crafting possibilities.

title: Dream Restaurant 3D
description: Ready for the ultimate restaurant challenge in Dream Restaurant 3D? Embark on a journey to establish your very own restaurant empire. The mission is straightforward: swiftly attend to customers, prepare delectable hamburgers, stack them up, and gracefully serve them around the tables. Expand your team by hiring proficient waiters, accumulate profits, and gradually construct an unparalleled restaurant empire!

title: Stickman Team Detroit
description:
It's team time now! Cartoon character The game of Team Detroit is fun to watch. A gang of robbers is threatening the city of Detroit, but three little stick figures will come together to stop them.

Take pleasure in killing off enemy stickmen while using any of the three playable characters. Because of their unique abilities and weaponry, each playable character is tailor-made for their specific role.

title: Pato Vs Cops
description: lay Pato Vs Cops — the ultimate free browser police chase game! No download needed — jump into nonstop car chases, dodge roadblocks, and outdrive relentless cops in fast-paced arcade action. Perfect for fans of unblocked racing games, endless car chase games, and online driving challenges. Show off your reflexes, collect power-ups, and see how long you can survive the heat in this thrilling high-speed pursuit!

title: Homo Evolution
description: Create your own world and guide human evolution! Merge creatures, unlock eight evolution stages, and shape civilization from tiny spores to modern life. Explore new planets, experiment with unique paths, and enjoy endless fun in this captivating evolution game. Play now!

title: Chroma Tower
description: Chroma Tower is a reverse-Tetris puzzle where you destroy instead of build! You're given a tower made of colored blocks. Drop blocks from above, match the color — and the entire connected chain disappears. Blocks fall to fill the gaps, potentially triggering new cascade reactions. Your goal is to demolish the tower completely within a limited number of moves.

title: Bubble Letters
description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Bubble Letters, an immersive word game that takes players on an extraordinary journey through the world of letters. Featuring vibrant floral backgrounds and tranquil gameplay, this online crossword adventure is the ideal companion for warm days ahead! With thousands of levels to conquer, you're guaranteed endless brain-teasing enjoyment. Embark on a blooming linguistic adventure today!

title: Bombardino Crocodilo terror jumpscare
description: Welcome to Bombardino Crocodilo: Terror Jumpscare, a spine-chilling horror game that will test your nerves, reflexes, and courage. In this twisted nightmare, you take on the role of an unfortunate visitor trapped inside a cursed, abandoned mansion. Your mission? Collect all the creepy dolls scattered across the dark, decrepit corridors and escape before its too late. Sounds simple? Think again.

title: Squid Challenge: Play to Survive
description: Squid Challenge: Play to Survive is an intense survival game inspired by the thrilling challenges of the popular survival contest. Players must navigate through a series of deadly trials, testing their reflexes, strategy, and nerve. With each level, the difficulty increases, making it a true test of skill and endurance.

title: From Nerd To School Popular
description: Embark on a transformation journey “From Nerd To School Popular”! Help our protagonist navigate high school life, overcome challenges, and discover their true potential. With your guidance, they’ll undergo a stylish makeover, gain confidence, and rise to the top of the social ladder. Experience the ultimate high school makeover story and watch as our hero transforms from a shy outsider to a beloved school icon!

title: Cars Merge
description:
Feel the thrill as racing cars zoom by at lightning speed on the track!

Get your hands on these incredible cars and watch them blaze across the raceway. Show off your passion for speed and excitement by collecting them all!

How many will you collect? Play now and find out!

title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
description:
Welcome to People Playground: Ragdoll Battle!
Carefully control your character to strike the right spots on your opponent’s body. Attack strategically to destroy and crush your enemies. Earn gold coins to unlock new characters and upgrade your skills.

With vibrant visuals, exciting challenges, and detailed progress tracking, this bubble shooter keeps you motivated to aim higher and improve every round!

title: Hole Defense
description: Enemies are coming to capture your castle. You need to protect your people from intruders by using everyhing you have: Digging holes, upgrading and recruiting new soldiers and using your special abilities such as summoning an aircraft, hurling a lava rock, releasing bombs from your balloon bombers and freezing them all. Don't let them capture your castle at all costs!

title: Hazel Tangle Rope 3D: Sorting Puzzle
description: Untangle colorful twisted ropes in this satisfying 3D brain-teaser puzzle game. Strategically select and move rope endpoints to separate tangled knots and sort them by color. Use logical thinking and spatial reasoning to solve increasingly complex rope puzzles and become a tangle master.

title: Human Evolution Run
description: Start with a skeleton, choose your evolution route.

title: Strawberry Hero
description: Stick your fork and climb to the top! Hold down to keep sticking the fork continuously. If your fork hits a hero or an obstacle, it’s game over! Stick the fork just above the falling hero’s feet to trigger a Super Jump and earn a high score!

title: Power Puzzle
description:
In Power Puzzle, you take control of a growing electrical network. Connect generators, route power through the grid, and bring every building to life — but every move matters.

? Gameplay
Connect power lines from generators to buildings
Manage limited connections and avoid inefficient routes
Every level is a handcrafted puzzle with increasing complexity
Multiple solutions are possible — can you find the most optimal one?

title: Timberland Arrange Puzzle Game
description:
Arrange the animals and color them! А refreshing reinterpretation of classic Tag and Sudoku. Assemble a logical puzzle by finding intersections between different types of hints. Enjoy colorful hand-drawn graphics, fascinating sounds of nature and cheerful cries of animals!

It may seem that the game is quite simple. However, level by level you will dive deeper into the rabbit hole, discover new mechanics, and the number of combinations will increase reaching hundred thousand!

title: Brain puzzles-Quests
description: This is the puzzle game filled with challenging, interesting tasks that will help you relax and have fun. There are games for training thinking, mental tasks, and IQ tests suitable for those who like to think. Develop logic, pump your brains!

title: Monster School 2
description: Monsters from minecraft are trained at the monster school by Herobrin's teacher. Take the tests, find out who is a Noob and who is a real pro in Bottle Flip challenge, parkour and roller coaster!

title: Boo-tiful Princess Match
description: Welcome to an exciting puzzle-game, created in a Halloween atmosphere. There are three princesses in the game and each one is ready for her own eerily beautiful transformation. The player will have to look for paired cards to discover new elements of the girls future image. Each successful match brings you closer to creating a unique costume, makeup or hairstyle. Only the most attentive players will be able to make their princesses truly scary-beautiful!

title: Mask Evolution 3d
description: Mask Evolution 3D is a parkour game. Move the masks through digital gates to boost the value of your mask. You can also collect decorations and attendants to make your mask even more artistic. Finally, auction your masks to sell them for a high price and earn more money. Please note,be careful of obstacles such as spikes on the road, they will devalue your mask and you will fail when your mask value is 0. Get ready for an exciting journey to make your very own mask!

title: Destruction of Stickman Zombie
description:
Take a weapon and destroy the zombie stickmen! "Destruction of Stick Zombie" is an exciting game in which you will fight against hordes of stickman zombies using your skills and strategies. You have to fight zombies to earn coins and improve your weapons.
You start the game as a regular player, but as you progress in the game, you become more experienced and skilled in combat. The more coins you earn, the more weapons and ammo you can buy.

title: Hamstercycle
description:
Help a genius hamster bust out of a mad professor's lab on his slick DIY ride - the Hamstercycle!

Jump across furniture and whatever junk the prof left lying around to reach the portal at the end of each room. But watch out - the floor is guarded by laser sensors! Touch it, and the hamster gets caught!

Fun physics, simple controls, and hundreds of exciting levels await!

title: Minicraft Chef Cake Wars
description: Hey player, would you like to have a cooking competition with your friend? In this cooking contest, you must beat your friend. Collect all the cooking materials as quickly as possible. We need to gather the cake ingredients floating in balloons in the air. The player who collects the most ingredients the fastest wins the game. To bake the cake, collect everything: salt, flour, and milk. Gather all the ingredients and win the game!

title: Solitaire L'Amour
description: Love is in the air. And so is Solitaire! Enter an enchanting world as you fall head over heels for this charming new Solitaire adventure!

title: Coin Color Sort
description: Dive into the colorful world of Coin Color Sort, an addictive online puzzle game that puts your sorting skills to the test. Arrange and match coins by color to create perfect stacks and clear each level. With its relaxing yet challenging gameplay, this free game offers endless fun and mental exercise. Play anytime on your computer or phone and see how far your logic can take you!

title: Match Masters
description: Match Masters is a real-time multiplayer match-3 puzzle game where players compete head-to-head on the same board. Each move requires strategic thinking, as it can benefit both you and your opponent. Utilize unique boosters, participate in tournaments, and climb the global leaderboards in this dynamic and engaging game.

title: Find the Sprunki
description: Find out the hidden Sprunki in the specified images. Each level has 12 hidden Sprunki. There are 12 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready, start the game and have fun!

title: Number Master
description:
A number elimination game, connect two numbers that are the same or add up to 10, eliminate them!Relax and match in a peaceful bamboo forest. 

If you enjoy logic puzzles like Sudoku, Merge Numbers, Ten Match, or CrossMath, Panda Match Ten is your perfect nature escape. Train your brain, improve your memory, and boost logic—all with the charm of adorable pandas and soothing bamboo forests.

title: Coe Snake
description: Coe Snake brings the classic snake game with new challenges! Collect fruits, dodge meteors, walls, bombs, and balls that move like ping pong. Multiple modes, scenarios, and fruits to choose from. Fast-paced, colorful, and addictive — how far can you go?

title: Draw To Home 3D
description:
Draw to home is a game to draw lines home. Everyone needs to return home according to their respective homes. This type of puzzle game is full of adventure with avoiding traps and obstacles on the way to finding a house.

Play a game of drawing a line to get home. It is very fun for children or teenagers to fill their days with this fun game.

title: Word Game 2026
description: Immerse yourself in "Word Puzzle," a premium brain-teasing game featuring a stunning 3D animated background! Test your vocabulary and fast-thinking skills by guessing the missing letters before the thrilling 30-second timer runs out. With 100 exciting levels, neon-glassmorphism graphics, and highly addictive gameplay, this game will keep you hooked for hours. Can you become the ultimate Word Master?

title: Racing Island
description: Explore, race and prove your mastery! Go on an adventurous journey with unique vehicles. Show off your skills in race, freeride and stand modes. Each level is full of new vehicles and discoveries. Are you ready for leadership?

title: Wordling: Daily Word Challenge
description: Wordling is a fun, free daily word puzzle game where you guess the hidden word in 6 tries using color-coded clues. Perfect for adults and seniors who love brain games, spelling challenges, and relaxing, ad-free gameplay. Explore all game modes!

title: Rescue Hero
description: The hero begins his journey for treasure and save princess, but the puzzles in front of the hunter trapped him. What you need to do is to pull the pins in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save princess away from dragon, wolf and monster safely.

title: Waterpark Sort
description: Play Waterpark Sort free online and enjoy a refreshing browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Organize colorful slides and splash pools in a relaxing logic puzzle that feels like a soothing brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game made for easy, satisfying sorting fun anytime.

title: Perfect Piano Magic
description: Perfect Piano Magic is a fun casual game. If you are a big fan of Piano Magic games, then this is a game you can't afford to miss! The gameplay of this game is extremely similar to Piano Magic, you need to shoot the blocks with a gun to capture the beat. You have three chances per game, start now and feel the real music when you click the blocks, enjoy the beats, and get ready to experience the delightful music and become a rhythm master!

title: Color Block Jam
description: Color Block Jam – an exciting puzzle game! Move the colored blocks, solve logic challenges, and complete levels. The game has many levels, from simple tasks to real brain teasers.

title: Idle Farm
description:
Run your own successful farm and build an empire! The more you grow and harvest, the more money you get!
Use the money to upgrade your fields and make harvesting even more effective at producing food. Keep an eye on your production - with careful planning you’ll achieve everything! Expand your farm further and further until you truly own an empire.
Hire farm managers to do most of the work for you. Use their help to expand your farming empire, plant new crops and produce even more food!

title: Stunt Car Extreme 2
description: Experience the exhilarating thrill of Stunt automobile Extreme 2, a remarkable 3D game that offers free access. Engage in extreme automobile driving on very challenging courses, which include moving platforms suspended in the sky. Navigate over intense obstacles and sharp bends to test your skills to the limit.

title: Makeup Stack
description: Would you like to make up? How many cosmetic brands do you know? In this game, these questions will get the answers. Let's play Makeup Stack game to make up for the customers. You will pass the various doors that you can choose as you like. As long as you can complete the task, it doesn't matter what you choose. Let's try this game right now to make up more people!

title: Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends
description: Welcome to Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends. Hello little girls. Are you ready for the latest spring fashion collection? Follow the latest fashion trends with these celebrities and create your own fashion clothes for next spring season. Browse their wardrobe to pick suitable outfits and costumes. Join and help them to welcome their favorite season.

title: Math Wall Simulator
description: Combine brainpower and action in this math-based Roblox adventure! Solve equations to break through walls, collect coins, and unlock new challenges. Progress through 20 classes of increasing difficulty, from basic arithmetic to extreme math puzzles

title: Army Defence Dino Shoot
description: Army Defence Dino Shoot is a third-person defense idle game. It seems that a lot of dinosaurs surround you. To protect the base from incoming dinosaurs, you can summon more soldiers and engineers to create a defensive line. Don't forget to upgrade your weapons, damage, and fire rate skills. The longer you hold this position, the more dinosaurs you will meet. Have a good time building a military base.

title: Fix The Hoof
description: Fix The Hoof is a soothing simulation game where you take on the role of a hoof care specialist, restoring and beautifying the hooves of animals like horses, cows, and goats. Enjoy deeply satisfying ASMR moments as you clean, polish, and paint hooves in this engaging 3D experience. Earn money from your services to upgrade your farm and expand your collection of animals to care for.

title: 2048 Number Match
description: Indulge your brain and enjoy puzzle-solving and number-matching. Achieve the highest possible score and boast about your brain-power!

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

title: Peg Solitaire
description: Engage your mind with the classic puzzle game, Peg Solitaire. The objective is simple yet challenging: clear the board by jumping pegs over each other until only one peg remains. This timeless game tests your strategic thinking and planning skills, offering various levels of difficulty to keep you entertained.

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: American Block Sniper Online
description:
With its informal look reminiscent of Minecraft, American Block Sniper Online is a top-notch first-person action game. In addition to a large variety of adversaries and stages, the game has an extensive arsenal of weaponry.
American Block Sniper Online is a first-person action game in the world of Minecraft where you must defeat all the enemies in each level before time runs out.

title: Downhill Car Ride: Crash Test
description:
Put on a real destructive show!

Forget about safety, in this game you need to check how strong the dummy is. At your disposal is a huge pile of dummies, an abandoned town, an incredibly huge arsenal and complete freedom of action! In this game you can check what will happen if you crash a motorcycle at full speed into a house with dynamite or what will happen if you jump out of the car a second before the accident!

title: Tap It Away 3D
description: Tap It Away 3D is a fun and relaxing 3D block puzzle game. Tap the arrows to move and clear blocks, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and plan your moves carefully as blocks can block each other. Enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay with no time limits. Play this free online puzzle game to relax, sharpen your logic, and train your brain anytime.

title: Parkour Block obby
description: Parkour block obby is a obby parkour where you need to pass obstacle courses. Collect diamonds, buy skins, get to the end and be the first!

title: Blox Fruits
description: Embark on an epic adventure across the seas in Blox Fruits, a Roblox MMORPG inspired by the world of One Piece. Choose your path as a Pirate or Marine, master powerful abilities granted by mystical Blox Fruits, and strive to become the strongest player in the game

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: Candy Cascade
description: Click on groups of two or more candies to destroy them. You need to collect certain amount of different sweets on every level.  Wooden blocks, honey and jam should be cleared from the game field. If there is a key on the game field it should be dropped down. The moves are limited for each level. If you have hard time with a task you can use bonuses that can be received when you collect jam.

title: Shape Transform Blob Racing
description: Shape Transform: Blob Racing is a casual running game. In this game, you will control a little Blob, running, shape-shifting, and go through various challenges! It would help if you quickly switched the Blob’s shape while running to navigate various obstacles. For example, turning into a ball helps you roll through narrow passages. When you become a square, it helps you cross flat areas more  easily.

title: Two Archers: Bow Duel
description: Get ready for a great battle at the Archery Tournament, because no one is going to just give up and let you win. With each new battle, your enemies will only become stronger. But you shouldn't stay put either. Buy new equipment. A huge selection of different bows will help you defeat your enemies, from simple wooden ones to magical golden bows with incendiary arrows! Earn money by participating in the tournament.

title: Geometry Missile
description: Navigate your missile through challenging geometric obstacle courses! Control a triangular missile that automatically flies forward while you tap to guide it up and down. Avoid collisions with various shapes like triangles, rectangles, and spikes to reach the gate at each level's end. Test your reflexes in this fast-paced arcade adventure!

title: Solitaire Klondike
description:
Step into the timeless challenge of Solitaire Klondike, an addictive HTML5 card game designed for fans of classic solitaire. Enjoy hours of relaxing gameplay with this popular version of Klondike Solitaire, where players arrange cards in descending order and alternate colors to win. If you need a fresh start, simply shuffle new cards to explore different winning strategies!
Perfect for anyone who loves solitaire,  Solitaire Klondike combines strategy, patience, and quick thinking.

title: Clean The Floor
description:
The house is so dirty. We need a cleaner ASAP.
Your job is to clean the floor spotless and make the owner satisfied as much as possible.
Use your vacuum machine to wipe out the dirt, and trash on the floor and make them clean again

title: Stickman Adventure
description: This is an adventure that will take you through time and space! Along the way, you'll encounter various traps and monsters; you'll need to defeat them and rescue your friends. Come on, Hero, a whole new world awaits!

title: Brainrot Boing Boing Merge
description:
Welcome to Brainrot Boing Boing Merge – a charming merge puzzle game where adorable creatures meet polished gameplay and juicy physics!

Merge. Match. Maximize
Satisfying Effects & Lively Details
Unlockable Skins System
Relaxing Yet Strategic

If you love satisfying merges, juicy feedback, and charming characters, this game is for you. Play now and see what creature you’ll create next!

title: Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight
description:
The zombie apocalypse has begun today!

Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight is an epic stick fighting game with cool effects and combos in the platformer genre.

The most epic battles and fights await you in a cube world similar to minecraft, where the red stick fights against zombies, skeleton archers, withers and even Noob!

The game is similar to Stick War, Stickman vs Zombies and Stickman Warriors. Hordes of zombies attacked the red stick and his friends!

title: Planet Merge
description:
Embark on an interstellar journey in the most thrilling puzzle game of 2025! Merge planets in a cosmic challenge and create a universe of fun.
imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Farm Block Puzzle
description: This is the perfect game to satisfy your craving for a logical tetris-inspired game with a fresh spin on it. The countryside aesthetic will capture your attention with its beautiful graphics and lovely music.

title: Chess Online
description:
Options:
- Choose an opponent from 18 difficulty levels from Beginner to World Champion
- Selection of time control modes: Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Classic
- Highlighting possible moves when choosing a piece
- Cancel the move, if there was a yawn, you can go back
- Interactive hints, showing the best move during the game
- Analysis after the game, highlights mistakes and gives recommendations on how to play
- Replay the game from the right place
- Setting the handicap

title: Strike Force: Action Platformer
description:
Step into the explosive world of Strike Force: Action Platformer — a high-octane, side-scrolling action shooter inspired by the legendary Contra series. Fight through thrilling levels packed with non-stop combat, deadly enemies, and intense boss battles.

Wield an arsenal of powerful weapons including handguns, rocket launchers, shotguns, machine guns, and devastating grenades. Master your reflexes and tactical skills to survive waves of relentless enemies!

title: Simon Super Rabbit
description:
Simon and his friends have turned into superheroes and now they must look for the evil Professor Wolf and get their marbles back.
Grrr… That boastful and braggart Professor Wolf and his minions don’t want to give the marbles back to Simon and they have challenged him to a super mega competition which he must win to get them back. If you beat him, he will be giving the marbles back to you. Surely you can win and get them all back. Go for it!

title: Cat Challenge
description: Meet the game Cat Challenge, where at each level the cat will patiently wait until you drop him a round colored candy disc. To do this, you need to cut the rope on which the candy dangles. But first, think about which side to do this and take into account the items that are on the playing field, they must be used to achieve the goal. The candy is not always directly above the cat, so it needs to be moved somehow.

title: Formula Racing Games Car Game
description: Let's Play and Enjoy car driving in all the Formula Race master 3D tracks of the world and become a champion on all the tracks of the world in the Formula Car Racing Game. Formula Car Stunts Games 3D introduces a new offline car racing game for the fans of the Formula Car simulator.

title: Obby Tower
description:
Climb. Think. Survive.

Ascend a towering obstacle course filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms — and surprise math challenges! Combine your parkour skills with quick thinking to make it to the top.

Perfect for players who love obbies and want to test both reflexes and brainpower.

title: Basketball Damage
description: Basketball bounce is an addictive endless basketball game. You can control the ball as you like. Time your tapping perfectly to score before the clock runs out. Keep going as long as you can!

title: Tap 3D Blocks
description: Layers upon layers of dice await your skillful touch. Some puzzles ask you to think. This one dares you to see the whole picture. Flip, rotate and reveal new tiles as you uncover unexpected paths. Boosters lend a hand, but the strategy is all yours.

title: Donne's Spinning World
description:
In this 2D puzzle-platformer, you can spin the entire world using magical leaves. Rotating the world changes gravity and helps you reach new paths.

The goal is to collect all the flowers in each level.
Along the way, you'll need to push boxes, open doors, and avoid spikes and silly monsters.

Jump, rotate, and solve puzzles in a colorful world full of fun challenges!

title: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run
description: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run is a stylish dress-up game where you join glamorous catwalk competitions. Pick the perfect outfit, match accessories, style your hair, and impress the judges. Travel to fashion shows around the world, earn points, unlock outfits, and become a global trendsetter. Win challenges to climb the leaderboard and prove your fashion sense. Every level brings a new style theme to conquer!

title: Words Match
description: This catchy combo of word search and spelling bee lets you create thousands of words with different lengths. Try to improve your score while hitting the targets presented in every unique level, and upgrade your word tiles to keep progressing! Relax and train your brain at the same time - can you pass all the levels in Words Match?

title: Wired Chicken Inc
description: Wired Chicken Inc is a fun casual game on yad.com. Do you dream of being a relaxed and free farmer and managing your farm? In this game, you can realize your dreams. At the beginning of the game, you only have one duck egg. The duck egg hatches a duckling, and the duckling then produces a duck egg. See what you can get in the last, enjoy!

title: Granny GTA Vegas
description: Granny GTA Vegas drops the infamous horror legend into the heart of sin city! Armed and unhinged, Granny escapes her haunted house and brings chaos to the neon streets of Las Vegas. With red-hooded masked enemies hot on her trail, she must shoot her way through crime-ridden alleys, casino districts, and the Vegas Strip.

title: Nugget Man Survival Puzzle
description: Are you ready for adventure with the Nugget man character? To save the Nugget Man character who is stranded in the desert, you must fly into the sky without bursting the balloons. You must be careful to take the character to the finish by solving the puzzles before time runs out, accompanied by Gedagedago music. Rescue Nugget Man through desert bandits, cacti and many other challenging obstacles! Enjoy.

title: Restaurant VIP Masterchef
description: Restaurant VIP is a game where you have to run a restaurant and bring your management skills to every diner! Survive the daily target to get high score.

title: Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room
description:
Horror brainrot bots are on the hunt! Watch out, stay alive!

Welcome to Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room – the ultimate brainrot meme horror escape game!

Get ready for heart-pounding chases as you find yourself trapped in backroom full of unpredictable Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala Bots and other viral meme creatures. Can you keep up with the chaos, dodge the brainrot traps, and make it out alive? Only the fastest runners will escape this nightmare.

title: Super Tank Wrestle
description: Welcome to the world of tank battles, where you can control tanks to fight with other enemies on different maps. There are also a wealth of tanks for you to choose from!

title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
description: Discover a new genre in the world of puzzles! This game intertwines block puzzles with a thrilling adventure on tropical islands! Complete levels to earn stars, unlock new territories and unique relaxation areas. From snow-white beaches to dense jungles – each location is filled with unique challenges. The booster system will help you in difficult situations, and the well-thought-out mechanics allow both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the game.

title: Chroma Trek
description:
Dive into the glowing world of Chroma Trek, a vibrant neon platformer where every step is a test of skill and perception. With dazzling visuals and a unique color-switching mechanic, each level feels like a handcrafted puzzle filled with dynamic challenges.

Shift colors to phase through obstacles, stay sharp to dodge traps, and be inspired by motivational messages that guide you along the way. Your goal? Reach the shimmering Finish Crystal and conquer every stage with style.

title: Black Cat Stacking POP
description: Tap tiles to clear them! When you tap a tile, any same-colored tiles next to it will also connect and clear together. Clear a bunch of tiles at once, and a toy mouse will appear to help clear even more! Clear target tiles or tiles that add moves to increase your remaining moves. The game ends when you run out of moves.

title: Frogga
description: Guide Frogga across a busy road in this exciting frogger-style game. Tap to make Frogga jump forward, timing your movements carefully to avoid the oncoming traffic. Each level presents new challenges with faster cars and trickier obstacles, keeping you on your toes. Collect bonuses and power-ups along the way to help Frogga on his journey.

title: Extreme Makeover Harley Edition
description: In the Extreme Makeover: Halrely Edition you witness the complete transformation of a famous villain. Are you ready to give it a try? Play it today and give her a full makeover routine, starting with removing the two signature colors in her hair, then dealing with her makeup, manicure, and more. Don't forget to also dress her up in something girly-girl and super-colorful so she can strut her stuff through the streets of Gotham City.

title: Enchanted Easter Adventure
description: Step into a magical springtime world in Enchanted Easter Adventure, where Lily and adorable bunny come together to celebrate Easter! This whimsical game combines storytelling, mini-puzzles, character dress-up, and holiday cheer in one unforgettable journey.

title: Klondike Solitaire
description:
Test your skill and logic with Klondike, the classic solitaire game loved by generations!

Stack the cards in ascending order, alternating colors, and complete all four suits to win the game.

With clean graphics, intuitive controls, and the option to play with one or three cards, Klondike offers hours of fun and relaxation.

Perfect for a quick break or a long strategic challenge!

title: Stick Rope Hero
description: Are you ready to become a super stickman hero? In Stick Rope Hero, you enter an exciting sandbox world filled with adventures and challenges. Swing around the open city with your powerful rope skills and completing many action tasks.

title: Escape the Horror Craft
description:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling horror adventure set in the Minecraft universe. A regular, unassuming worker in Minecraft's universe becomes disoriented and has to figure out how to get out of each level and map in order to do the jobs.

A Minecraft nightmare comes to life in this eerie, ghostly realm. Stay calm as you navigate the terrain in search of an escape. Is it possible to complete each level without dying? If you're looking for a new game to play, check out kiz10.com.

title: Slide Them Away
description: Slide Them Away is a puzzle game. In each slider puzzle, you will see a grid with colored grid edges with squares inside these borders. The squares are the same color as the grid edges. The number of colors may vary. Each slider puzzle aims to get rid of all blocks locked within the edges of the grid.

title: Cat Life Merge Money
description: Experience the life of a stray cat, beg from humans, earn money to buy food, and merge the money you beg to get more money. Only by acting quickly can you enter the rich cat life! First of all,all you need to do is click on the cat and let it beg all the time. Otherwise, it will be lazy.

title: Kids Supermarket
description: Welcome to Kids Supermarket, a casual supermarket simulation game for kids. Have you ever gone shopping alone? Feel confused about finding goods among a large number of products? Join Kids Supermarket to elevate your observation and categorization skills. Our diverse and clearly aligned products will make you feel like shopping in a real-life supermarket. Pick up your shopping basket and start your journey in the supermarket.

title: 2048Skill Edition
description: Ini adalah permainan kesenangan untuk 2.048, dan terutama kami telah menambahkan permainan dan keterampilan baru yang memungkinkan pengguna untuk mengalami 2048 berbeda.

title: Drunk Man 3D
description: Drunk Man 3D is a challenging and comedic 3D Ragdoll Physics game. In this game, players must navigate a treacherous cityscape while emulating the hindered balance of inebriation. The game features ragdoll physics, where even minor collisions can cause players to lose control and stumble.

title: Unscrew Them All
description: Unscrew Them All is a challenging  puzzle game where players must strategically unscrew all the screws securing large wooden planks to the board. After removing each screw, place it into the correct open slot. Unscrew all the planks before time runs out to complete each level. Master every level to win the game!

title: Wacky Strike
description:
This time you will choose who are you actually. Well, no. Who is the strongest! Girls, or boys! So, just build a lot of towers, and buy your cool enemy! Fight like the real hero and you will cope with it, just try it!

Are you a good fighter? Then this game is for you! Just pick a side, setup your troops, and fight against your mortal enemy, do you think that it is so easy?! Then march from your castle to the enemy castle claiming ground in between.

title: Obby Draw to Escape
description:
Have a blast in Obby illustrating your way to victory! Play the fun and relaxing casual game Draw to Escape and see if you can overcome the levels' issues using just your creativity.

You may earn money as you go through the levels, and you can earn even more coins when you reach the end of each level for every star you find. Things may vanish or explode and kill you, so be sure to check every level thoroughly.

title: Mahjong Riddles: Egypt
description:
Welcome to the mysterious world of Ancient Egypt! Find matching tiles, solve mahjong levels and collect artifacts to uncover secrets of Giza valley, Old city, Desert and Nile.
Discover how the Great Pyramid of Giza was constructed, how Egyptians learned to read hieroglyphs, why only the pharaoh could own a cat in Ancient Egypt and many more. 
Simple and engaging gameplay of mahjong solitaire is the best way to relax. You will find huge treasures, tricky locks, new bonus tiles and more.

title: Beauty World and Fashion Stylist

title: Hyper Nurse: Hospital Games
description: Get ready to navigate through the fast-paced world of healthcare, where every second counts. Your mission as a hyper nurse is to provide exceptional care to patients, manage critical situations, and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital. Get ready to put your multitasking skills to the test as you juggle multiple tasks and make crucial decisions in hyper nurse: hospital games.

title: Stick Kill 3D

description: Dive into the addictive world of Line of Hole! Start with simple lines, progress to complex patterns. Earn coins for each level, unlock vibrant backgrounds. Use hints when stuck, test your logic, and enjoy endless fun!

title: Hypermarket 3D: Store Cashier
description:
Step into the world of retail and build the supermarket of your dreams!

Take charge as the supermarket cashier, master time management, and turn your small store into a thriving grocery empire.

title: Slice it Up
description: Slice It Up is a colorful arcade puzzle where precision is key! Cut fruits, toys, and other shapes exactly in half to earn stars. The closer your slice is to the center, the better your score. Simple controls, smooth animation, and bright graphics make every level fun and challenging. Test your reflexes, aim for three stars, and unlock new levels in this exciting game for all ages!
